correctness.rationale: The canonical n=10 degree-four zonal harmonic Y(s)=s^4-3s^2/7+1/56 yields a positive C2 support function h_t=1+tY for |t|<56/143 from exact principal-curvature polynomial extrema. Independent exact rational Beta-moment reconstruction (s^2~Beta(1/2,9/2), projection z~Beta(1,4)) produced M1 coefficients 1,0,363/12544,-1573/153664,4492917/550731776 and M2 coefficients 1,0,363/6272,-1573/76832,4968273/275365888 through degree four. The second and third logarithmic comparison coefficients cancel, while the fourth equals (M2_4-2 M1_4-M1_2^2)/20=139863/3147038720>0. Direct expansion of support-function projection volumes and their negative moments, rather than numerical sampling, proves Delta(t)=positive*t^4+O(t^5) for sufficiently small t of either sign; it does not settle unrestricted affine monotonicity.

originality.rationale: The full Chen–Li–Wang arXiv:2604.26828v3 text, sections 1,3–5, establishes a fourth-harmonic second-variation coefficient proportional to ((m+2)(k+2)-n-2) and reversal only above the threshold. Its first critical integer case n=10,m=1,k=2 makes the quadratic term zero; the source states O(t^3) remainder, not the vanishing cubic and explicit positive fourth-order coefficient. Resultary searches found no distinct covering n=10 critical quartic calculation. General affine-quermassintegral and flag integral inequalities do not imply this signed higher-order coefficient.
residual_risks: Other unpublished critical-dimension perturbation analyses or higher variation tables may duplicate the coefficient.
Positivity is along one canonical harmonic family only; unrestricted monotonicity at n=10 remains open.
